data_fields.name: max_view_distance
data_fields.donor_constant: MAXDISTANCE = 5000 (footprint width shrinks by (MAXDISTANCE - view distance) / 100)

best_idea: Draw the minimap as one pixel per tile fitted to a fixed box, show only what the player can see, flash the player's own unit for two seconds after a hit, and draw the camera footprint as a trapezoid turned by yaw.
decision_why: Keep the fixed box, the camera footprint and the hit flash; the visibility filter must come from the server's per-player snapshot (server-verified rule), and blink must come from the game tick, not a draw-pass timer (donor defect fixed in the sketch).
acceptance: In a zone fight a player sees a 128 px minimap with dots for enemies in aggro range, their own dot flashes for 2 s after a hit, a selected ally dot dims for half of each 1 s cycle, and the footprint turns with the camera; a server test asserts the snapshot sent to a player holds no entity outside that player's view range.
